<thought>We need to find templates that break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond and form a new C‑C single bond. Using the correct functional group names (“ketones”, “C-C triple bonds”) and bond format (“6-6” for a new C‑C single bond, “6-8” for a broken C‑O bond) we can search the template catalog for suitable retrosynthetic templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
